subject: Draft: Stakeholder plan + evaluation timeline for Arcadia POC
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Oliver Barnes <oliver.barnes@arcadiathx.com>, Sara Mann <sara.mann@arcadiathx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder plan + evaluation timeline for Arcadia POC

Hi Oliver / Sara —

Thanks again for the time earlier. To keep momentum on the POC and make the commercial timeline predictable, I drafted a starter stakeholder & evaluation plan that we can iterate on together. The goal is to have a shared MAP (mutual action plan) that captures:
- Decision owners and approvers
- POC success criteria and pass/fail tests
- Milestones (workshop, POC delivery, evaluation window, procurement PO)
- Target close date and any procurement gating items

I've attached a lightweight template (Arcadia_MAP_Template_v1.docx) — please:
1) Add the internal stakeholders and expected approvers on page 1
2) Fill in the evaluation criteria (technical and business) by EOD Mon (18 Aug) if possible
3) Confirm a target close date — our suggested date is 2025-09-30

Would you be available for a 30-min alignment session next week to review the MAP and the technical test plan? Proposed: Aug 22 at 10:00am PT.

Link to live doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/Arcadia-POC-MAP-Deck

Thanks — looking forward to iterating.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: 2025-08-15_Arcadia_MAP_Template_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Oliver Barnes <oliver.barnes@arcadiathx.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sara Mann <sara.mann@arcadiathx.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stakeholder plan + evaluation timeline for Arcadia POC

Vanessa —

Thanks for this and the template. That looks useful. A few quick notes from our side:
- Aug 22 workshop works for us (10:00am PT is fine). I'll invite the clinical leads.
- For the evaluation window, can we target a slightly earlier POC completion of Sep 25? We want to present outcomes to the leadership committee on Sep 29.
- Procurement (Sara) will need an initial SOW and SOC2 evidence; we should make those explicit milestones in the MAP.

I'll ask Sara to draft the procurement milestone text and share any procurement timeline constraints.

--
Oliver Barnes
Head of Data & AI
Arcadia Therapeutics
oliver.barnes@arcadiathx.com

On a related note: please add a contact for contract/legal so procurement has a direct person to ping.

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>
To: Oliver Barnes <oliver.barnes@arcadiathx.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stakeholder plan + evaluation timeline for Arcadia POC

Thanks, Oliver — great context.

I've put together a concise technical evaluation checklist and a proposed test schedule that maps to the MAP milestones. Highlights:
- Week 1 (post-workshop): environment setup and data ingestion (smoke tests)
- Week 2: baseline perf tests (latency/cost) + functional tests on core flows
- Week 3: edge-case tests and failover behaviors; regression checks with our sample prompts
- Week 4: final report and hand-off to Arcadia clinical leads

I've uploaded the test checklist (Arcadia_Tech_Checklist.xlsx) and seeded a live doc with the draft test cases: https://docs.google.com/document/d/Arcadia-POC-MAP-Draft

A few asks for the MAP so we can run clean tests:
- Confirm a canonical dataset subset and point-of-contact for data refreshes
- Confirm expected throughput for the POC (concurrent sessions / average seq len)

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: Arcadia_Tech_Checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Oliver Barnes <oliver.barnes@arcadiathx.com>, Sara Mann <sara.mann@arcadiathx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated draft + slides (please comment)

Hi all —

I pulled in Connor's checklist and Oliver's notes and updated the MAP deck. Key changes:
- Added procurement milestones (SOW deliverable & SOC2 evidence check)
- Added contact rows for contracts/legal and procurement owners
- Set POC target completion to 2025-09-25 (per Oliver) and suggested close date 2025-09-30

Please review the slides and leave comments directly on the doc by EOD Mon (18 Aug) if possible: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/Arcadia-POC-MAP-Deck

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ARC-2025-0921

Proposed next steps:
- Aug 22: joint technical workshop (Vanessa/Connor + Arcadia clinical & infra)
- Aug 25: procurement checklist completed by Arcadia
- Sep 25: POC delivery & report
- Sep 29: leadership review
- Sep 30: target contract signature / close

If procurement needs an SOW template from us, I can attach. Also happy to take a short procurement-only call with Sara.

Thanks — appreciate quick feedback so we can lock milestone owners.

Best,
Vanessa

Attachment: (updated slides referenced in link)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated draft + slides (please comment)

Team —

Nice work pulling this together. A couple of product/ops asks before we send the next version to the customer:
1) Add a procurement milestone that requires a PO (purchase order) as a gating milestone before we consider the deal closed. Make PO date explicit in the timeline.
2) Add a line for "support & SLA" that we can hand to legal for inclusion in the SOW.
3) Track any approved commercial concessions (credits/discount) in the MAP as an "approval item" with approver/date (if discounts are requested, we need finance + sales leadership sign-off).

Vanessa — once the MAP reflects the PO milestone and SLA note, please send an updated link to Oliver and Sara and ask procurement to confirm dates. I'll review any commercial concession requests separately — flag them to me and Marissa.

David Kim
Director, Sales Operations
David.Kim@redwood.inference.com

(On internal next steps: I will clear any small promotional credits. Marissa, please prepare the concession tracker row.)
